title: Cyclic natural product oligomers: diversity and (bio)synthesis of macrocycles
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,396-464
DOI: 10.1039/D2CS00909A, Review Article
Songya Zhang, Shuai Fan, Haocheng He, Jing Zhu, Lauren Murray, Gong Liang, Shi Ran, Yi Zhun Zhu, Max J. Cryle, Hai-Yan He, Youming Zhang
This graphical abstract compares enzymatic and chemical macrocyclization of cyclic natural product oligomers, highlighting bacterial, fungal, and plant enzymes, alongside chemical methods like ring-closing metathesis, lactonization, disulfide bridges, and cycloaddition.
